MATCH (s:Statute)-[:CONTAINS_PROVISION]->(p:Provision)
WHERE toLower(s.state) = 'alabama'

WITH s, p,
  (CASE WHEN toLower(p.name) CONTAINS 'eviction' THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN toLower(p.rule) CONTAINS 'eviction' THEN 18 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN toLower(p.rule) CONTAINS 'residential' THEN 16 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN toLower(p.rule) CONTAINS 'tenant' THEN 14 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN toLower(p.rule) CONTAINS 'landlord' THEN 12 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN toLower(p.rule) CONTAINS 'termination' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN toLower(p.rule) CONTAINS 'lease' THEN 8 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN toLower(p.rule) CONTAINS 'possession' THEN 6 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN EXISTS {
     MATCH (p)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(:AreaOfLaw {
       name: 'Landlord-Tenant and Housing'
     })
   } THEN 12 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.type IN [
     'Procedure or Process',
     'Duty or Obligation',
     'Notice Requirement'
   ] THEN 8 ELSE 0 END)
  AS score

WHERE score > 0

WITH s, p, score
ORDER BY
  score DESC,
  coalesce(p.name, ''),
  coalesce(p.rule, ''),
  elementId(p)

WITH s, max(score) AS score, head(collect(p)) AS best

WITH
  s,
  best,
  score,
  COLLECT {
    MATCH (best)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(c:Condition)
    WITH DISTINCT c
    RETURN {
      number: c.number,
      description: c.description
    } AS condition
  } AS conditions

RETURN
  s.idx AS statute_idx,
  s.citation AS citation,
  s.summary AS source_summary,
  best.rule AS provision_rule,
  conditions,
  score

ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 20
